title: The Hateful Memes Challenge: Detecting Hate Speech in Multimodal Memes
reasoning: The paper presents a benchmark for hate speech detection that specifically includes 'Religion' as one of the primary protected categories for evaluation (making up 39.3% of the dev set). It evaluates models on their ability to identify attacks and hate speech directed at religious groups, which is a core component of benchmarking religious and ethical boundaries in AI.
